title: Bootcamp
body: All new members go through a two-week bootcamp together, with lectures on technical skills and fun socials to bond with your new class.
imageAlt: New DSS members out together on Durant Avenue in Berkeley at night, holding cups of frozen yogurt

title: Professional Development
body: Workshops and prep sessions built around what students are actually recruiting for, run with people who've recently been through it.
imageAlt: A DSS project team in business attire presenting their work to seated members in a classroom

title: Networking
body: Time with alumni, industry partners, and members across every committee — the relationships that outlast any one semester.
imageAlt: DSS members seated around tables listening to speakers at an evening alumni and industry event

title: Community
body: Socials, traditions, and the people you'll be around every week — the part members say kept them here.
imageAlt: DSS members covered head to toe in coloured powder, crowded together and smiling at an outdoor Holi celebration
